thread:
Priya Nair: Heads-up - nightly-scan failed for release/canary. SAST flagged payments/validator.go (unvalidated currency code) as high. DAST crawler couldn't fetch test fixture archive: KMS decrypt returned 403. Also saw an infra rollout earlier today. @Hannah @Diego can we triage quickly?
Diego Morales: paste the scan output?
Priya Nair: https://ci.example.com/runs/99012 - scan-bot below
scan-bot: nightly-scan 4309999000: result=FAIL, sast:1 high (payments/validator.go), dast:1 medium (fixture fetch), infra: artifact-fetch KMS_DECRYPT=403 for principal=fixture-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Hannah S.: copying artifact log: ```ERROR: crypto: Decrypt call failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes. resource=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/artifact-decrypt, principal=fixture-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
Luca M.: that text "insufficient authentication scopes" usually maps to missing iam.binding at key level or role removed. infra-rollout today was a repo-owned policy sync from infra-automation. Could be they used `--format=json > out && apply` which clobbered key bindings.
infra-automation: automated-deploy 4309900123: applied IAM policy sync at 2026-04-02T02:10Z for project:redwood-prod (see change: https://infra.example.com/changes/2301)
Diego Morales: I'll run an auditlog slice: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type="cloudkms_key_ring" AND resource.labels.key_ring_id="infra"' --limit 20 --project=redwood-prod` and share results.
Hannah S.: SAST note: payments/validator.go - missing check for empty currency leading to panic on Parse(); I think it's a real bug. We shouldn't suppress. I'll take that and open a quick fix PR.
Priya Nair: for unlocking scans, propose granting fixture-uploader roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key with a conditional binding that expires in 2 hours. Ops to apply only after Diego confirms the binding is missing (and attach audit evidence).
ops-oncall: suggested gcloud (templated): ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding artifact-decrypt --keyring=infra --location=global --member='serviceAccount:fixture-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-02T05:00:00Z'),title=short_term_scan_unblock,description=temporary unblocking of nightly scans" --project=redwood-prod``` I'll hold until thumbs-up.
Diego Morales: auditlog results: found SetIamPolicy by infra-automation at 2026-04-02T02:10Z that replaced key IAM for keyRing infra. It removed a binding for fixture-uploader. Adding evidence to ticket CH-2301 and pinging infra team.
Priya Nair: ok ops, you have permission to apply after you attach the CH-2301 evidence link. Ops, please prefer key-level binding (not project-level) and include change with TTL.
Hannah S.: PR for SAST fix: https://github.com/redwood/payments/pull/312 (adds empty-check + unit tests). ETA 2h. Will also add a regression test to the SAST eval harness to catch this pattern.
Luca M.: DAST failure also complained about missing fixture archive causing crawler auth timeouts. Once artifact fetch restored, re-run DAST. Could be flaky test gating otherwise.
infra-automation: cc @team-infra - we rolled out a policy bundle to standardize roles. We didn't intend to remove key-specific decrypters. Investigating why the generated policy omitted those bindings.
Diego Morales: small follow-ups: - create incident stub if we see more than one project impacted - add a preflight task in nightly pipeline to `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for the fixture key - build a small audit correlation script to show who removed bindings within a timeframe
ops-oncall: applying conditional binding now (attached to CH-2301 evidence). Command executed with audit annotations.
scan-bot: re-run queued. (re-run id: 99013)
Priya Nair: quick decision on suppression: payments bug -> no suppression; fix required. If any SAST are low-confidence next time, mark as potential fp and assign owner.
scan-bot: re-run 99013: overall=PASS, sast=PASS, dast=PASS, infra=artifact-fetch=OK
Priya Nair: Nice. Closing actions: - Hannah to merge SAST PR and backport to release branch - Diego to draft a short postmortem and coordinate with infra to update the IAM generation templates to keep key-level bindings - ops to ensure conditional binding has TTL and document the one-off change in CH-2301 - add nightly preflight `kms keys test-iam-permissions` step and a small audit-correlation helper in tools/security.
Hannah S.: PR merged, backport queued.
Diego Morales: incident stub INCIDENT-2026-04-02-kms-rbac-scan created: https://tracker.example.com/INC-6789 - attaching logs and commands. Assigning postmortem owner to Priya.
Priya Nair: taking postmortem owner. We'll keep this blameless and focus on guardrails (policy generation tests + preflight). Thanks team. :slightly_smiling_face:
